serviceName: A certificate for a name behind Cloudflare's proxy
description: Lets Heaven get the certificate of one name whose visitors reach it through Cloudflare's proxy: _acme-challenge at the name, a CNAME to the organization's address. Heaven applies it with the name as the host, or without one for the domain itself.
variableDescription: label: the first label of the organization's address, LABEL.domains.heaven.dev: 3 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
